description: CF_HTML behind a UTF-8 BOM whose offsets were computed as if the BOM were not there
notes: Every offset is three bytes short. StartHTML lands inside the header and is clamped up to the end of it, and the fragment comes from the <!--StartFragment--> comments, which move with the content — so both survive. What does not is the tail of the context: EndHTML under-reports by three and the last three bytes of </html> are cut. That is the documented cost of reading the offsets as BOM-inclusive, and it is why bom_len is exposed.
